API Key Management - Store API keys in environment variables - Rotate keys regularly - Use different keys per environment 2. Access Control - Implement rate limiting - Configure IP allowlists - Use principle of least privilege 3. Monitoring - Enable audit logging - Monitor auth failures - Set up alerts for suspicious activity ## Installation ### Installing via Smithery To install Better Auth MCP Server for Claude Desktop automatically via [Smithery](https://smithery.ai/server/@nahmanmate/better-auth-mcp-server): ```bash npx -y @smithery/cli install @nahmanmate/better-auth-mcp-server --client claude ``` To use with Claude Desktop, add the server config: On MacOS: `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` On Windows: `%APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` ```json { "mcpServers": { "better-auth-mcp-server": { "command": "node", "args": ["/path/to/better-auth-mcp-server/build/index.js"], "disabled": false, "alwaysAllow": [] } } } ``` ### Debugging Since MCP servers communicate over stdio, debugging can be challenging.
